title: One-step tilt-excess decay (Simon 5.4.5 with p = 2n and bounded H)
statement: For n ≥ 1 and k ≥ 0 there are θ₀ ∈ (0, 1/4] and δ₂ ∈ (0, 1/8] such that for every δ ∈ (0, δ₂] and all data satisfying (SA_δ): U, W ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with W open and W ⊆ U; R = (M, θ, ξ_R) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n; ξ_R = R.orient is its orientation, and ξ below denotes a point) with μ := R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M; H : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ^{n+k} μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |H(x)| ≤ κ for all x; R.firstVariation X = −∫⟨X, H⟩dμ for every C¹ compactly supported X with tsupport X ⊆ W; ρ > 0 with the closed ball B_ρ(z) ⊆ W; z ∈ spt μ; μ(B_ρ(z)) ≤ (1 + δ)ω_nρⁿ (ω_n = unitBallVolume n); κρ ≤ δ: for every ξ ∈ spt μ ∩ B_{δρ}(z), σ ∈ (0, δρ] and n-dimensional subspace T there is an n-dimensional subspace S with E_*(ξ, θ₀σ, S) ≤ θ₀E_*(ξ, σ, T), where E_*(ξ, r, S') := max{r^{−n}∫_{B_r(ξ)} |p_x − p_{S'}|² dμ, κ²r²/δ} ∈ [0, ∞]. Here p_x is the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x, p_S the orthogonal projection onto a subspace S, |A|² := Σ_i |Ae_i|² the Hilbert–Schmidt norm (the Lean sum over EuclideanSpace.single i 1), B_t(y) the closed ball, and integrals of nonnegative functions are lower Lebesgue integrals in [0, ∞] (Lean ∫⁻ of ENNReal.ofReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∃ θ₀ δ₂ : ℝ, 0 < θ₀ ∧ θ₀ ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ 0 < δ₂ ∧ δ₂ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ δ₂ → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k)) (κ ρ : ℝ) (z : Euclid (n + k)), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → closedBall z ρ ⊆ W → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid (n + k) → Euclid (n + k), ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → z ∈ R.measure.support → R.measure (closedBall z ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n) → κ * ρ ≤ δ → ∀ ξ ∈ R.measure.support ∩ closedBall z (δ * ρ), ∀ (σ : ℝ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))), 0 < σ → σ ≤ δ * ρ → Module.finrank ℝ T = n → ∃ S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), Module.finrank ℝ S = n ∧ max (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / (θ₀ * σ) ^ n) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ (θ₀ * σ), ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) (ENNReal.ofReal (κ ^ 2 * (θ₀ * σ) ^ 2 / δ)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ₀ * max (ENNReal.ofReal (1 / σ ^ n) * ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ σ, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin (n + k), ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - T.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) (ENNReal.ofReal (κ ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 / δ))
